title: Joining a gym
instructions: Kerem bir spor salonuna üye olmak istiyor. Üyelik türlerine ve fiyatlara dikkat et.

script.speaker: kerem
script.text: Hi. I'd like some information about joining the gym.

script.speaker: staff
script.text: Sure. We have two types of membership. The full membership is forty pounds a month.

script.speaker: staff
script.text: The day membership is twenty-five pounds, but you can only come before four in the afternoon.

script.speaker: kerem
script.text: I work until five, so I need the full one.

script.speaker: staff
script.text: OK. With full membership you can also use the swimming pool and join the classes.

script.speaker: kerem
script.text: Great. I'd like to try a yoga class. When are they?

script.speaker: staff
script.text: Every Monday and Wednesday at seven in the evening.

script.speaker: staff
script.text: Yes. I just need a photo and your bank details.

questions.prompt: How much is the full membership?
questions.feedback: Tam üyelik ayda kırk pound (forty pounds).
questions.evidence: The full membership is forty pounds a month.

questions.prompt: Why can't Kerem have the day membership?
questions.feedback: Günlük üyelik sadece saat dörtten önce geçerli; Kerem beşe kadar çalışıyor.
questions.evidence: I work until five, so I need the full one.

questions.feedback: Yoga her pazartesi ve çarşamba akşam yedide.
questions.evidence: Every Monday and Wednesday at seven in the evening.

options: a photo and his bank details
his ID card and his address
questions.feedback: Bir fotoğraf ve banka bilgileri gerekiyor.
questions.evidence: I just need a photo and your bank details.
